title: Adaptive Dynamic Programming: Solltrajektorienfolgeregelung und Konvergenzbedingungen
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: In this work, discrete-time and continuous-time methods that integrate flexible reference trajectory representations into Adaptive Dynamic Programming approaches are presented and analyzed for the first time. Moreover, theoretical conditions on the system state are derived that ensure the persistent excitation property, which is crucial for the convergence of the adaptation. Real-world applications of the presented adaptive optimal trajectory tracking control methods reveal their potential.
